what_this_is_not: This does not claim the engines raise the same exception class (rlang_error vs ArgumentError), the same message text, or the same behaviour for a class one engine does handle. R's .gllvmTMB_site_trait_sim and .gllvmTMB_va methods are excluded from the Julia twin by the P1 case map (PR #526). Julia's own MethodError for fit types with no getLV method is a different path from this fallback and is not measured here.
